# Welcome

I build reproducible statistical tools and analysis for regulated manufacturing, with a focus on SPC, DOE, capability analysis, and practical visual methods. My work centers on clarity, correctness, and helping real people solve real problems with data.

## Featured Project: SPCtools

A modern SPC package in R designed for human‑readable logic, metadata, and opinionated defaults that reflect real operational needs.

- GitHub repo: [SPCtools](https://github.com/benjepson/SPCtools)
- Documentation (pkgdown): *coming soon*

## About Me

I’m an industrial statistician/data scientist with experience in regulated manufacturing, analytical method support, process validation, and continuous improvement. I earned an MS in Applied Statistics from KUMC and have used R for over a decade.
